evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Imperative directive issued as a settled instruction the speaker expects compliance with — performed declarative settling, not an argued position.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Operational imperative with 'all' as an absolute scope marker — performed as a settled instruction, not a position under argument.
